title: At the café
instructions: Mark bir kafede sipariş veriyor. Fiyat, saat ve isim gibi ayrıntılara dikkat et.

script.speaker: waiter
script.text: Good morning! Welcome to Sunny Café. What would you like?

script.speaker: mark
script.text: Good morning. Can I have a coffee, please?

script.speaker: mark
script.text: Large, please. And a cheese sandwich.

script.speaker: waiter
script.text: OK. A large coffee and a cheese sandwich. Anything else?

script.speaker: mark
script.text: No, thank you. How much is it?

script.speaker: waiter
script.text: That's seven dollars and fifty cents.

script.speaker: mark
script.text: Here you are. What time do you close today?

script.speaker: waiter
script.text: Can I have your name for the order?

script.speaker: waiter
script.text: Thank you, Mark. Your coffee is ready in five minutes.

questions.prompt: What does Mark order to drink?
questions.feedback: Garson "Small or large?" diye soruyor, Mark "Large" diyor. İçecek kahve.
questions.evidence: A large coffee and a cheese sandwich.

questions.feedback: "Seven dollars and fifty cents" = 7,50 dolar. "Fifty" (50) ile "fifteen" (15) karıştırılmamalı.
questions.evidence: That's seven dollars and fifty cents.

questions.prompt: What time does the café close today?
questions.feedback: Kafe saat altıda kapanıyor. Sonda geçen "five minutes" kahvenin hazırlanma süresi, kapanış saati değil.

questions.prompt: What is the name of the café?
questions.feedback: Garson ilk cümlede kafenin adını söylüyor: Sunny Café.
